$comment: Acceptance criteria for issue 32. The command checks assert BEHAVIOUR at both ends -- agreement where the transports can agree, and declared absence where one genuinely cannot answer.

criteria.target: echo '{"issues":[{"id":"ENG-101","title":"x","status":"Backlog","statusType":"backlog"}]}' | ./adapters/linear query roadmap_authority get_authority id=ENG-101 --input - | jq -e '.value.authority == "ADMITTED"'
echo '{"issues":[{"id":"ENG-101","title":"x","status":"Backlog"}]}' | ./adapters/linear query roadmap_authority get_authority id=ENG-101 --input - | jq -e '.error.type == "MALFORMED_SOURCE"'

echo '{"issues":[{"id":"ENG-200","title":"c","status":"Backlog","statusType":"backlog","parentId":"uuid-x"}]}' | ./adapters/linear query roadmap_authority get_parent_or_goal id=ENG-200 --input - | jq -e '.unknown.reason == "PARENT_NOT_RESOLVABLE_ON_TRANSPORT"'
